methods.method_description: Verifies that Evernote successfully landed on the reauthorize page after clicking the sign in button
methods.method_purpose: Validates the presence of the Evernote reauthorize page header title to confirm successful navigation to the reauthorization screen

methods.method_description: Verifies that an Evernote account has been successfully added to the account list
methods.method_purpose: Confirms the Evernote account name is visible in the list, indicating successful account addition

methods.method_description: Verifies the cloud screen displays all available cloud provider options
methods.method_purpose: Validates the presence of all cloud provider buttons (Box, Dropbox, Evernote, Facebook, Google Drive, Instagram, Other) and the add account title on the cloud screen

methods.method_description: Verifies that a specific cloud account has been successfully added to the account list

method_input_parameter.parameter_purpose: Specifies the name of the cloud account to verify in the list

methods.method_purpose: Confirms that the specified cloud account name is visible in the account list, indicating successful account addition

methods.method_description: Verifies that a specific cloud account is not present in the account list

method_input_parameter.parameter_purpose: Specifies the name of the cloud account to verify is absent from the list

methods.method_purpose: Confirms that the specified cloud account name is not visible in the account list, indicating the account was not added or has been removed

methods.method_description: Selects a specific cloud account from the account list

method_input_parameter.parameter_purpose: Specifies the name of the cloud account to select from the list

methods.method_purpose: Performs a click action on the specified cloud account name to select it from the list

methods.method_description: Logs out a specific cloud account by clicking sign out and confirming the action

method_input_parameter.parameter_purpose: Specifies the name of the cloud account to log out

methods.method_purpose: Executes the logout process for the specified cloud account by clicking the sign out button and confirming the sign out action

methods.method_description: Verifies that a specific cloud account has been successfully logged out

method_input_parameter.parameter_purpose: Specifies the name of the cloud account to verify logout status

methods.method_purpose: Confirms that the sign out button for the specified cloud account is no longer visible, indicating successful logout

methods.method_description: Verifies that the cloud album screen is displayed for a specific cloud account

method_input_parameter.parameter_purpose: Specifies the name of the cloud account whose album screen should be verified

methods.method_purpose: Validates the presence of the album title for the specified cloud account, confirming successful navigation to the cloud album screen
